kind: deploy files against frame-api.jar on this PC (no Linux, no systemd)

checks.name: 1a deploy files are LF-only (no CR, no BOM)
1b unit: java -jar with an absolute java and jar path, exit 143 is success, no Node left
1c the install guide puts the jar and the environment file where the unit reads them
1d relay.env.example: plain NAME=value lines only (no quotes, backslashes, $, %, inline comments)
1e the unit permits only stats and VOD archive writes while source recordings stay read-only
2a the jar starts with the variables of relay.env.example (paths, port and MediaMTX API address replaced; no MediaMTX runs), without a settings warning
checks.summary: FRAME API 0.3.0-spring: 1 publisher token(s); renditions []; DVR on; HLS on; media grace 15000 ms; playback stats /var/lib/frame-relay/stats; legacy page /opt/frame-relay/ui/index.html

checks.name: 2b the JVM options line of relay.env.example is picked up by java
2c RELAY_LISTEN_HOST=127.0.0.1: the LAN address of this PC refuses the connection
3a /healthz: the Spring backend, MediaMTX reported unreachable (503) rather than a crash
3b the legacy page, its hls.js and font are served from the installed ui folder
3c the token file is read: its token announces (204, media not ready), another token is refused (401)
3d a playback report is appended to RELAY_STATS_DIR (one CSV per day, no address in it)
3e /info: announced without media -> running, mediaReady false (viewers wait)
4a a value out of range (RELAY_MAX_VIEWERS_PER_PATH=0): no start, the log names the variable
checks.line: Reason: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: RELAY_MAX_VIEWERS_PER_PATH must be an integer in 1..100000

checks.name: 4b a malformed rate (RELAY_RATE_ANNOUNCE=fast): no start, the log names the variable
checks.line: Reason: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: RELAY_RATE_ANNOUNCE must look like 30/5 (burst/perSecond)

checks.name: 4c a switch that is no switch (RELAY_DVR=maybe): no start, the log names the setting frame.… and the value
checks.setting: Failed to bind properties under 'frame.dvr.enabled' to boolean:
checks.value: Reason: failed to convert java.lang.String to boolean (caused by java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Invalid boolean value 'maybe')

checks.name: 4d on/off are read as switches (RELAY_DVR=off, RELAY_HLS=on): the service starts with DVR off
checks.summary: FRAME API 0.3.0-spring: 1 publisher token(s); renditions []; DVR off; HLS on; media grace 15000 ms; playback stats <tmp>/var/lib/frame-relay/stats; legacy page <tmp>/opt/frame-relay/ui/index.html

notCovered: systemd on Linux: the sandbox directives with a JVM, SuccessExitStatus=143, stop time, FFmpeg children in the control group
Caddy with deploy/Caddyfile.example (the test Caddyfile is checked by https-check.mjs)
